capabilities: Display the Things3 Today task list in an Obsidian pane
Mark Things3 tasks as complete with a single click
Refresh the task list automatically every 30 seconds or manually
extras: Mac-only: the README requires Things3 installed and running on your Mac, and macOS permission prompts must be allowed for task updates.
motivation: The README says it is designed to help users seamlessly integrate task management with their note-taking workflow in Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or update tasks from the Things3 app, so users must switch apps to check their today list.

relations.evidence: view and manage your today's tasks from the Things3 App directly within an Obsidian pane

summary: Things3 integration that shows your Things3 Today task list in an Obsidian pane and lets you complete tasks with one click.
